source.detail: cloudflare OAS corridor pair b61f904f10c9 -> 7abe88500e55 (removals subset ingested 2026-08-01)

spec_evidence.checked: Walked both cached specs: the path /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/events/{event_id} exists in BOTH specs, but its method set shrinks from [delete, get, patch, post] in OLD to [get, patch, post] in NEW — the DELETE operation alone was withdrawn while the rest of the resource survives.

alternative_data_source: the same event resource remains readable and editable via the surviving GET and PATCH operations on the identical path

fix.migration_guide: Delete or gate every call site that issues DELETE against cloudforce-one events: the verb now returns method-not-allowed. Removing the delete invocation (and any UI affordance wired to it) is the mechanical mend; if soft-deletion semantics are needed, PATCHing the event into an archived state is the surviving write surface, but adopting that policy is a product decision outside the codemod.
fix.example_after:
// DELETE on cloudforce-one events was withdrawn upstream; call removed.
// The event remains readable via GET and editable via PATCH on the same path.
